# Emergency upgrade — ZKsync-OS VT restore + L1 CAH migration relax (stage)

One-off emergency upgrade executed via the `EmergencyUpgradeBoard`, bundling two
PUH-owned `ProxyAdmin.upgrade` calls. Generated from
`deploy-scripts/upgrade/EmergencyValidatorTimelockRestore.s.sol` at era-contracts
commit `6430dea61` (branch `kl/anvil-hardening`), against Sepolia (chain 11155111).

> Supersedes the earlier draft that targeted CAH impl `0x544C…b07F` (which gated the
> `SLHasDifferentCTM` check on non-L1 origins). Commit `6430dea61` **fully removes** that
> check, changing the `L1ChainAssetHandler` bytecode and hence its CREATE2 address. The
> proposal id therefore changes, so every `approveHash` value below is new too.

- CREATE2 factory `0x4e59b44847b379578588920cA78FbF26c0B4956C`, default salt (`CREATE2_FACTORY_SALT` env unset).
- VT/MultisigCommitter bytecode is unchanged from the prior commit, so its address is identical (not re-broadcast).
- Constructor args: VT impl `(bridgehub=0x236D1c3Ff32Bd0Ca26b72Af287E895627c0478cE)`; CAH impl `(owner=0x8f08627524aeD610192132A425D6b9C32a1727EF, bridgehub=0x236D1c3Ff32Bd0Ca26b72Af287E895627c0478cE)`.
